data.description: Park Lane: A Blend of Comfort and Modern Design in JVC
data.display_address: Park Lane by Heilbronn, Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai
data.long_description:
Introducing Park Lane, a prestigious 7-storey residential complex by Heilbronn Properties, setting a new standard for upscale living in Dubai. Designed with an unwavering focus on quality and detail, this development offers a selection of studios, as well as one to three-bedroom apartments, perfectly tailored for contemporary living. Each unit is crafted to enhance natural light, fresh air, and space, while featuring sleek modern kitchens and generously sized rooms.

Park Lane's impressive range of amenities includes a large infinity pool, Padel tennis court, panoramic fitness studio, children’s play area, and a tranquil yoga zone. Whether enjoying the rooftop garden for social gatherings or finding peace in the meditation spaces, residents have endless opportunities to relax and connect.

Nestled in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Park Lane combines suburban tranquility with the convenience of city living. It boasts easy access to major attractions and business districts, with key distances like 3 minutes to Five Jumeirah Village Circle, 7 minutes to Circle Mall, 12 minutes to Dubai Hills Mall, 19 minutes to Mall of The Emirates and Business Bay, and 21 minutes to Dubai Marina, Burj Al Arab, and Jumeirah Beach.

Finance is available on this property through Premier Property Finance. Call us on +97143233609 for a free consultation.
